privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: The platform runs on your own server (self-hosted). Personal data is minimal: name, email, language, time zone and — optionally — a Telegram chat identifier.
privacy.p2: Student data is never shared with third parties and is not processed by analytics. There are no trackers or ad scripts. The only external service is the Telegram Bot API: it receives the chat identifier and the notification text.
privacy.p3: Video lessons go through a media server installed on the same server — no third-party video clouds are used. Lessons are not recorded.
privacy.p4: Deleting the account removes notes, sheets and class memberships; the request is in the “Profile” section.
